notes: The scenario first establishes and partially removes directed publications using the already verified set-based service. It then calls the standard class-scoped unpublish overload for the remaining directed publications on both object classes and queries through standard HLArequestPublications. Ordinary object and interaction publications remain unchanged. The directed report is checked against the exact NULL response semantics in the IEEE 1516.2-2025 standard MIM. This scenario does not cover DDM regions or claim provider-independent conformance.

requirements.statement: The scenario invokes the IEEE 1516.1-2025 class-scoped Unpublish Object Class Directed Interactions overload for each class with a remaining directed publication.

After no directed interactions remain published, the standard MIM emits exactly one directed-publication NULL response with HLAnumberOfClasses equal to zero, omits HLAobjectClass, and supplies an empty HLAinteractionClassList; ordinary publication reports remain unchanged.
